description: This file contains unit tests for socket connection and idle state detection functions within the starboard namespace, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests various scenarios such as invalid sockets, connected sockets, and listening sockets, including IPv4 and IPv6 configurations.

classes.name: SbSocketIsConnectedAndIdleTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing socket connection and idle state detection with different socket address types.

classes.name: PairSbSocketIsConnectedAndIdleTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing socket pairs with different address type combinations.

methods.name: GetAddressType
methods.description: Returns the socket address type parameter for the test.

methods.name: GetServerAddressType
methods.description: Returns the server socket address type parameter for the test.

methods.name: GetClientAddressType
methods.description: Returns the client socket address type parameter for the test.

methods.name: IsNonIdleWithin
methods.description: Checks if a socket becomes non-idle within a specified timeout period.
